motion: Select one joint tank motion. Avoid shells. If a verified AIM hit direction exists, turn toward that heading (positive delta RIGHT, negative LEFT), including wall-bounce directions. Do not substitute the enemy bearing for a ricochet heading. Otherwise follow the navigable waypoint. Compare the forecasts and choose drive and turn together.
drive: Choose forward, reverse, or stop. The barrel is fixed to the hull; turn and weapon are separate choices. Avoid all shells.
turn: Choose hull rotation. Use the verified firing direction or navigation waypoint in context. Left is negative angle, right is positive.
weapon: Which statement matches the shot forecast for the selected motion? The fixed barrel turns with the hull before the single firing attempt.
weapon.fire: This is a safe shot that can hit the enemy.
weapon.hold: This shot is unsafe, misses the enemy, or the weapon is not ready.
